description: Manually verified SO3 32px glyph bitmap SHA-256 prefix to Unicode evidence. This file concentrates on non-unanimous CJK OCR and visually distinct Japanese old/new-form pairs.
key_policy: sha256_prefix contains the first 12 hexadecimal characters and is unique within unique_32px_glyphs.csv.

audit_summary.context_source: The embedded 32px mclib message table (1,220 messages) was decoded by source glyph index and checked against the atlas.

homograph_checks.resolution: U0052 is 一 in personal names; U0011 and other dash-shaped slots are non-kanji by message context
U0071 is 二 in 皆川浩二; U0063 is ニ in アニメーション and シニア
U0091 is 口 in 山口幸宏; U002E is ロ in チェロ
U0090 is エ in 戦闘エフェクト and エンジニア; no true 工 glyph occurs in this atlas
U00A8 is 夕 in 鳥潟夕佳; U0058 is タ in ギター and キャラクター
U0165 is カ in ランカー, テクニカル, and カンパニー; no true 力 glyph occurs in this atlas
U00AF is 人 in 雅人, 康人, 真人, and other personal names; no 入-shaped source slot occurs
U0126 is ハ in ハクスリー, シーハート, and ハモンド
U0140 is small ォ in ヴォックス and ウォルター; U0177 is オ in オーボエ and ヴァイオリン
U0027 and U0152 are ト in キャスト and ラトル
